## Checklist

- [ ] The base branch is `dev`.
- [ ] `scripts/check.sh` passes (it runs every check the CI runs).
- [ ] A change to the panel comes with the rebuilt bundle (`npm run build` in `custom_components/smart_irrigation/frontend`).
- [ ] New texts are in `en` (and in `de` if you speak it; the other languages are done by the maintainers and on Weblate).
- [ ] A bug fix comes with a test that fails without the fix.
- [ ] The docs (`docs/`) say what changed, where users will see it.
